description: This file contains unit tests for the Azure Table Storage persistence provider within an Orleans-based project, including tests for serialization formats, storage conversions, and different storage backends (memory, file, Azure). The tests ensure correct reading, writing, format conversions, and environment support checks.

classes.name: PersistenceProviderTests_Local
classes.description: A test class for verifying Azure Table Storage persistence provider functionalities including serialization formats, storage conversions, and environment checks within an Orleans project.

classes.name: TestStoreGrainStateWithCustomJsonProperties

methods.name: InitAzureTableGrainStorage
methods.description: Initializes an AzureTableGrainStorage instance with specified serialization and format options.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_Read
methods.description: Tests reading grain state from a storage provider and verifies the data integrity.

methods.name: Test_PersistenceProvider_WriteRead
methods.description: Tests writing to and reading from a storage provider and checks consistency.

methods.description: Tests writing, clearing, and reading grain state to verify proper storage state management.

methods.description: Checks if the testing environment supports large state sizes or Azure Storage, invoking emulator utilities if necessary.
